description_en: Carcinoma in situ or pre-invasive disease with no evidence of regional lymph node involvement or distant metastasis
Early-stage disease characterised by a localized primary tumor without lymph node involvement or distant metastasis
Locally invasive disease with larger tumor size or limited regional lymph node involvement
Locally advanced disease characterised by extensive regional tumor spread or extensive lymph node involvement
Advanced disease characterised by distant metastasis beyond the primary organ or regional lymph nodes
Disease confined entirely to the organ of origin without spread to regional lymph nodes or distant sites
Disease that has spread beyond the primary site to adjacent tissue or regional lymph nodes
Disease that has spread to distant organs, anatomical regions, or distant lymph nodes
Broad categorisation for disease in its initial phases, typically encompassing Stages 0 through II
Broad categorisation for disease that has progressed significantly, typically encompassing Stages III and IV
Reappearance of disease after a period of remission or complete therapeutic response
Disease stage cannot be assessed or is not documented in the clinical record
